resolved.evidence: c-explain now reads 「`/explain-diff` を作っていれば使い、なければ「今の差分を説明して」と頼みます。返ってきた説明の1か所を、自分の言葉で言い直します。」. A learner who followed p-more's 「なければ足しません」 can now finish the step and meet its expect.

scores.evidence: Both objectives are can-do statements with Bloom verbs (設計できる, 判断できる). o1 is assessed by q1, q2, e1 and e2, and o2 by q3, q4 and e3, with apply/evaluate items in each set. The off-objective e4 is gone. The create-level o1 is performed in practice-setup, and the scored items for it are selected-response.

hook-b1 is a concrete 3-sentence scenario (「初日にスキル（skill）5つとフック（hook）3つを一度に入れようとして、手が止まりました」) and is followed by the ungraded pq0. pq0's explanation now states the day-1 exception (「ただし、秘密情報とpushの守りは例外で、初日から置きます」), so the rule no longer contradicts the example.

The prerequisites name the exact earlier lessons. dr-table's 「学んだ回」 column ties each part to the lesson that taught it. The only new term, きっかけ, is defined in dr-b1 (「同じ困りごとが繰り返し起きること、つまり[[きっかけ]]です」) and matches the glossary, and the recalled terms link to glossary entries.

Re-measured after the c-explain change. measure.mjs: 「prose 1210 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 1703 · practice reading 1654 · questions 8 · practice sections 3 · est 18.8 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」. estMinutes 19 still matches the rounded estimate, and lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.

ex-steps has 5 steps with subgoal titles, each step's trigger or reason (「整形の忘れが続いたので」), an expect for each, and full artefacts (ex-prompt-claude-md, ex-settings, ex-prompt-skill), all before practice. ex-b1 now gives the timeline (「①と②は初日に置き、③と④は、きっかけが起きた週に1つずつ足しました」). There is no faded step between the full example and independent practice.

4 of the 5 content sections end in an inline check (q1–q4), never 2 in a row without one. The checks are apply/evaluate items set in new situations, with feedback on every wrong option. q4's stem now describes a symptom (「Claudeが、前の作業の前提を混ぜ始めました」) rather than naming the checklist item.

All 7 misconceptions in the brief map to distractors. Each feedback is 2 sentences or fewer and gives a reason (q2 b 「拒否すると、package.jsonを変えたときにも入れられなくなります」; q3 d about reviewers asked to find faults). dr-b2 now gives both the day-1 exception and the limit of the rules (「`git -C . push` のような別の書き方のpushは、止まりません」).

cycle-flow has 5 nodes plus a review loop, and its labels match the cycle-steps titles exactly (「別のコンテキストでレビューする」). Its caption states the takeaway (「レビューで直す指摘があれば、実装と検証に戻る」) and the alt text is complete. dr-table is a real comparison, and there are no decorative images.

c-explain now works whether or not the learner built the skill (「`/explain-diff` を作っていれば使い、なければ「今の差分を説明して」と頼みます」), which matches p-more's 「なければ足しません」. Every step has an expect, the model answers come after the hints, and self-check-list is the success checklist. c-review and c-commit still have no hint or troubleshoot, so the hint ladder is incomplete.

The summary comes after the exam and has 4 points. A reflection prompt follows (「自分で判断した場面を1行で書いておきましょう」), then a next step (「演習3で決めた部品を足していきましょう」) and advice for keeping up with changes. There are 7 flashcards in です・ます and 3 askTutor suggestions.

The three audit-confirmed fixes are in: ex-prompt-skill's /reload-skills uses the betterFix text, setup-prompt-model's expect says 「Pythonのスクリプトが開くファイルは防げません」, and card-ask names `git -C . push`. The previous issues are also fixed: e1 now says 「一致した操作を…止めます」 and check-quiz cites cc-memory. Versions are pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.283). Two places still state more than the docs: sc-safety 「pushの前に確認が入ります」 has no limit attached, and ex-claude-md's expect omits the restart that p-restart says is needed.

The new c-explain text keeps です・ます and the non-pressuring tone (「作っていれば使い、なければ…頼みます」), and its prompt 「今の差分を説明して」 matches the course's other quoted requests. Elsewhere 「別のコンテキストで」 and 確認ルール/拒否ルール still match the glossary, and lint finds no banned phrase.

The single declared locale (jp) is complete, including the diagram labels. Plain-text fields hold no markdown: checklist labels use 「/clear」 instead of backticks. The link text is descriptive (「公式ドキュメントの日本語版」), cycle-flow has full alt text, and no text is baked into images.

niceToHave: c-review (cycle-steps) has no hint or troubleshoot. Add hint 「指摘が多すぎたら、計画の要件に関わるものだけに絞ってと頼みます。」
c-commit (cycle-steps) has no hint. Add hint 「1行目が長すぎたら、「何を変えたかを1行目に50字以内で」と頼みます。」
p-claude-md's 「25行以内」 is unexplained, while e3 a's feedback calls 40 lines fine under the official 200-line guide. Change p-claude-md's hint to 「最初は25行以内を目安にします。各行に「消したらまちがえる？」と聞きます。」

Factual doubt: ex-claude-md's expect 「`/context` の「Memory files」に出ます。」 has no condition, but p-restart says 「直したCLAUDE.mdと設定は、起動し直すと読み込まれます」 (cc-prompt-caching: CLAUDE.md loads on the next /clear, /compact or restart). Change it to 「起動し直すと、`/context` の「Memory files」に出ます。」

sc-safety (self-check-list) restates the guarantee that dr-b2 qualifies (「pushの前に確認が入ります」), and the audit also names this label. Change it to 「安全：秘密情報の拒否ルールと、git pushの確認ルールを書きました」. Labels render as plain text, so use no backticks.
summary-points[1]: change 「必ず守らせたいことは、権限ルールとフックに置きます。」 to 「Claudeの判断に任せず止めたいことは、権限ルールとフックに置きます。」 to match dr-b2.
sc-b1 calls an unmet checklist item a きっかけ, but the glossary defines きっかけ as 「同じ困りごとが繰り返し起きること」. Change 「当てはまらない項目が、次に足すもののきっかけです。」 to 「当てはまらない項目が、次に足すものの候補です。」

worked (to reach 4): add a faded step before practice-setup. For example, add a q-style prompt where the learner picks the part for ③ before seeing it, or leave one ex-steps item's md for the learner to complete.
summary: Verification round: review-scope exited 0, and only cycle-steps (c-explain) changed, 2% of the parts. The one open must-fix is resolved. c-explain now gives a fallback (「なければ「今の差分を説明して」と頼みます」), so the step can be completed under p-more's rule. validate and lint --strict are clean. measure.mjs gives est 18.8 min against estMinutes 19 and prose 1,210. Load, practice and voice were re-scored. Every criterion is 3 or higher, the mean is 3.77, and there are no must-fix items. The niceToHave list carries over the earlier suggestions and adds a hint for c-commit.
